title: Assam Buranji, or A Chronicle of Assam from the Earliest Times to 1696 A.D.
title_english: Assam Buranji, or A Chronicle of Assam from the Earliest Times to 1696 A.D.
author: Dr. Suryya Kumar Bhuyan, M.A., B.L. (Editor) / Harakanta Sadar Amin & American Baptist Mission Archives
category: Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS) Primary Texts
provenance: Shillong: Government of Assam / Gauhati: DHAS / DLI (2015.336000)
description: Primary Assamese Buranji discovered in the archives of the American Baptist Foreign Mission Society in Gauhati, transcribed and critically edited by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan. Records the political, military, and administrative history of Assam from the arrival of Sukapha to the end of King Gadadhar Singha's reign in 1696 A.D. Features authentic Tai-Ahom loanwords, administrative titles (Barbarua, Bargohain, Buragohain), and frontier negotiations with the Nora and Himalayan tribes.
